name: power-mode-reborn
description: Power Mode, reborn for modern VS Code. Your code is powerful, unleash it! A maintained fork of hoovercj/vscode-power-mode with fixes for VS Code 1.88+.

powermodeReborn.presets.description: Choose between different preset gifs to use when powermode is activated

enumDescriptions: Show the combo in the editor. The true 'Power Mode' experience
Use the status bar. A more subdued experience.
Use the default value. May be overiddent by other settings.
powermodeReborn.combo.location.description: Control where all the combo information is visible.

powermodeReborn.combo.threshold.description: The combo number needed to activate POWER MODE!!! and start shaking and exploding the screen! If the value is 0, POWER MODE will always be active.

powermodeReborn.combo.timeout.description: The number of seconds before the combo resets. If the value is 0, the timer will never reset.

enumDescriptions: Use the default value. May be overridden by other settings.
powermodeReborn.combo.counterEnabled.description: Control whether the combo counter is visible.

powermodeReborn.combo.counterSize.description: Control the size of the Combo Meter text

enumDescriptions: Use the default value. May be overridden by other settings.
powermodeReborn.combo.timerEnabled.description: Control whether the combo timer is visible.

powermodeReborn.shake.enabled.description: Set to false to disable shaking while typing

powermodeReborn.shake.intensity.description: The intensity with which the screen shakes

powermodeReborn.explosions.enabled.description: Set to false to disable explosions while typing

powermodeReborn.explosions.maxExplosions.description: The maximum number of simultaneous explosions

powermodeReborn.explosions.size.description: The size of the explosions. For value X, the height is set to X rem and the width to X ch

powermodeReborn.explosions.frequency.description: The number of key strokes needed to trigger an explosion. 2 means every second keystroke will explode, 1 means every key stroke.

powermodeReborn.explosions.offset.description: The vertical offset of the explosions. Increasing it will move the explosions up, decreasing it will move them down.

powermodeReborn.explosions.customExplosi.markdownDescription: This value will go into the 'url()' part of a background image. It should be a base64 encoded gif or **https** URL _without_ quotes.

enumDescriptions: Uses the gifs as a mask to let the background color come through (similar to atom power mode)
powermodeReborn.explosions.backgroundMod.description: Affects the css properties used to display the gif.

enumDescriptions: Resume playing it from its previous point
Restart the gif each time it is shown. This is useful when you have multiple visible gifs, but may reduce performance
powermodeReborn.explosions.gifMode.description: Control the 'playback' mode of the gifs.

powermodeReborn.explosions.explosionOrde.description: Determines how the explosions are cycled. 'random' (default) picks from the list randomly. 'sequential' goes through the list in order, and a number will select the explosion at that (zero based)index in the list

powermodeReborn.explosions.duration.description: Determines how long an explosion lasts (in milliseconds). Set to 0 for it to last forever.

powermodeReborn.explosions.customCss.description: Set custom CSS that will apply to the explosion element.

powermodeReborn.enableStatusBarComboCoun.description: Set to false to disable showing the combo in the statusbar
powermodeReborn.enableStatusBarComboCoun.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `powermodeReborn.combo.location` and `powermodeReborn.combo.counterEnabled` instead. This will be removed in a future version.

powermodeReborn.enableStatusBarComboTime.description: Set to false to disable showing the timer in the statusbar
powermodeReborn.enableStatusBarComboTime.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `powermodeReborn.combo.location` and `powermodeReborn.combo.timerEnabled` instead. This will be removed in a future version.
